steps.title: Vendanges Tardives
steps.body: Vendanges Tardives, VT, means late harvest. Grapes from the four noble varieties are left on the vine into late autumn, concentrating sugar. Minimum sugar levels are high and set by grape. VT wines can be dry, off-dry or sweet; they're rich, intense and long-lived.

steps.title: Sélection de Grains Nobles
steps.body: Sélection de Grains Nobles, SGN, is made from berries affected by noble rot, Botrytis cinerea, picked one by one. Minimum sugar is even higher. SGN wines are lusciously sweet, with honey, dried apricot and candied citrus, balanced by acidity. They're made only in good years and can age for decades.

steps.prompt: Order these Alsace styles from least to most concentrated.
steps.explanation: Later picking and noble rot concentrate sugar.

steps.title: Sweetness on dry wines
steps.body: Even regular Alsace wines can range from dry to off-dry, which confuses buyers. Many producers print a sweetness scale on the back label, and since 2021 rules encourage clearer terms like sec, demi-sec, moelleux and doux. Gewürztraminer and Pinot Gris are more often off-dry than Riesling.

steps.explanation: Sélection de Grains Nobles uses botrytised berries.

steps.title: What you learned
points: VT is late harvest, from dry to sweet
SGN uses noble rot berries and is lusciously sweet
